title: Depth bound for XOR reduction
statement: Let $n,k$ be nonnegative integers and let $ps$ be a list of pairs of Boolean circuit trees on $n$ variables, with $|ps|\le k$. Define the pair depth of $ps$ as the maximum, over its pairs, of the larger depth in each pair, taking this maximum to be $0$ for the empty list. The maximum depth of the two circuits returned by the fuel-bounded XOR reduction is at most the pair depth of $ps$ plus $2\lceil\log_2 |ps|\rceil+2$, where the ceiling is understood as the least integer $m$ such that $|ps|\le 2^m$.
hypotheses_covered: $ps$ is a list of pairs of circuit trees on $n$ variables
